text: I traded a car that was financed thru Truist on XX/XX/XXXX. I'd purchased XXXX XXXX at the time I purchased the vehicle. I reached out to Truist to obtain a status on my XXXX refund and they told me they'd sent a refund to me on XX/XX/XXXX. They sent the check to an address that was never on my loan. I've resided at the same address since that car was purchased XX/XX/XXXX, and they have not explained why the check was sent to another address. They told me they could not stop payment on that check or reissue because they were going thru a system conversion and could not give a date when they'd send out a new check. I've called every week since and I keep getting the same story. I've asked to speak with leadership and to date no one has called me back and my check has not been processed as of this past XXXX XX/XX/XXXX when I last called.
